background_image_description: Full-bleed photographic backdrop: soft-focus green-yellow bokeh foliage filling the upper ~70% with bright highlights toward the top-right and deeper green toward the lower-right; bottom ~30% is a warm brown wooden plank tabletop in perspective with visible grain, seams between boards, and subtle specular highlights.

nodes.svg_description: Dark brown decorative quote-and-line frame: at top-left, a pair of solid opening quotation marks (rounded teardrop shapes) followed by a short horizontal line extending right; directly below, a thin vertical line drops down forming a left bracket. At bottom-right, a mirrored thin vertical line rises up forming a right bracket with a short horizontal line extending left terminating in a pair of solid closing quotation marks. All strokes/marks share the same color (#4a372d) with rounded ends; stroke thickness of lines ~8–10 px.
